custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two bin locations at the test location, bin location A and bin location B.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test with 2 in bin location A (the first bin row) and 5 in bin location B, saved with neither bin marked Default.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425631-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425631-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inventory section lists bin location A with 2 as the first row and bin location B with 5 as the second; neither row is marked Default.

Step 2:

  • The first bin row, bin location A, is now marked Default and bin location B is not.
  • The quantities are unchanged: 2 and 5.

Step 3:

  • The window closes with no bin error.
  • Part A's Total Qty shows 7 Available (2 + 5 = 7), and Bin Location / Quantity shows bin location A with 2 and bin location B with 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R8: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the dialog marks the first one as the default.”
  • S5-E2: “A part reaches S5-R8 with bin locations and no default in two ways: the bin location that was its default is deleted in Settings → Parts → Bin Locations while the part holds 0 there, or an untracked part is saved with bin locations and none marked default.”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 5: “Save an untracked part with bins and none marked default, then turn tracking on.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
